scenario: I’ve been helping my aunt sort her medications ever since she began experiencing seizures. Recently, my aunt received a new prescription that she clearly hates taking due to how she despises swallowing pills. Her doctor told her that if she didn’t take her medication, her next seizure would be fatal. Right now, it is the scheduled time for my aunt to take her medication. She is refusing to take it. If I shove the prescribed medication down my aunt's throat, I can make my aunt take her medication and she will continue to live. If I do not do this, my aunt will experience a fatal seizure and die.
outcomes: My aunt does not receive the medication
